from src.agui import LLMUsageEvent
from .observations import emit_observations, field_observation_requests

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from src.agui import GraphOperationCompletedEvent
from src.logging import get_logger

from .models import LangfuseHandles
from .observations import emit_observations, graph_operation_observation_request
from .observer import _LoggedLangfuseErrors

logger = get_logger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LangfuseGraphOperationObserver:
    handles: LangfuseHandles

    def observe_graph_operation(self, event: GraphOperationCompletedEvent) -> None:
        with _LoggedLangfuseErrors(
            operation="graph_operation_observation",
            run_id=self.handles.identity.run_id,
        ):
            logger.info(
                "Langfuse graph operation observation boundary",
                run_id=self.handles.identity.run_id,
                operation_id=event.operation_id,
                phase=event.phase,
            )
            emit_observations(
                self.handles.client,
                [
                    graph_operation_observation_request(
                        self.handles.identity.langfuse_trace_id,
                        event,
                    )
                ],
            )


__all__ = ["LangfuseGraphOperationObserver"]
